scientific_claim: a stable PBP outcome core can exceed the strongest simple outcome forecast, after which narrowly scoped context or contact-quality residuals may add value without replacing terminal outcomes

candidate_ladder.purpose: reduce fold sensitivity without adding new predictors
candidate_ladder.change_from_C0: one global convex probability blend with Marcel
candidate_ladder.selection: choose one weight by mean training-origin player-and-PA terminal log loss; ties within 1e-8 choose the larger C0 weight
restrictions: one weight for every player and outcome

candidate_ladder.prerequisite: S0 passes its disclosed development gate
candidate_ladder.change_from_core: ALL-age mover translation residual on common nested links only
candidate_ladder.rare_policy: retain core conditional shares exactly; absolute mass may move only as required by an eligible parent link and simplex coherence
candidate_ladder.fallback: zero residual when an eligible level path lacks support

candidate_ladder.prerequisite: evaluate separately against the same passing core; do not combine with L0

candidate_ladder.model_form: regularized low-dimensional residual with all ten bins retained compositionally
restrictions: direction bins never receive direct run values

candidate_ladder.target: the same future terminal-outcome and wOBA residual
candidate_ladder.fallback: missing tracking sets increment and reliability to zero and returns the exact PBP prediction
candidate_ladder.overlap_rule: PBP-only and fused scores use identical players and outcomes

combination_policy: no increments are automatically stacked; each passes separately and any proposed combination requires a new preregistration

development_promotion_rule.fold_rule: strictly beat the strongest of C0 and Marcel on all four primary metrics in every required fold and both views
development_promotion_rule.supported_subgroup_reversal: forbidden under the already-frozen Stage 2f material-reversal thresholds
development_promotion_rule.calibration: must pass component, wOBA-decile, and level aggregate guardrails
development_promotion_rule.failure: final for that candidate; no rescue on validation results

scientific_invariants: probabilities are finite nonnegative exhaustive and normalized
out_to_1B_to_2B_to_3B_to_HR mass movement raises value monotonically
target-season outcomes context membership parks priors and run values cannot affect predictors
player names and identities are not predictors
contact-shape and tracking comparisons preserve identical cohorts
removing tracking returns the exact PBP prediction
tracking reliability converges smoothly to zero with evidence
